why: Main picture is a posed family/photo-op shot of Suryakumar Yadav standing between his wife and Prime Minister Modi in front of flags. It is not a cricket picture, shares the frame equally with two other people, and has nothing to do with a Mumbai chase or Mayank Yadav's 5 for 14. It looks like a stand-in. Also the story is a Saturday November 14 match report (about 44 hours old) and ends 'Mumbai and Delhi go into round two as winners' when round two may already have been played; the run found no round-two results.
